name: Bloodstone Choker
summary: In Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder’s Bloodstone Choker binds a warlock’s rite to the void. His apprentice stole the talisman and fled to the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Stolen Conduit
sections.body: Gakin the Darkbinder, a warlock mentor beneath Stormwind’s Slaughtered Lamb, once held the Bloodstone Choker. His apprentice Surena Caledon betrayed him and stole it. She fled into Elwynn’s forests and joined the Defias Brotherhood, taking the enchanted talisman with her. Now she is at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. The choker must be reclaimed before the bandits use its power.

sections.title: Taming the Void
sections.body: Carved from bloodstone, the choker bridges the mortal world and the twisting shadows of the Twisting Nether. In the crypts beneath the tavern, Gakin channels its magic at the summoning circle. A hostile Voidwalker answers from the void. A warlock must face the furious creature in direct combat and subdue it while wielding the talisman. Only then is the will to command such a guardian proved.

faq.answer: Warlocks use the Bloodstone Choker, an enchanted bloodstone necklace, as a ritual conduit. Its magic can tear through reality and summon an unruly Voidwalker from the Nether.

aliases: where did the choker come from
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder first owned the choker. He trains warlocks in a covert basement beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter.
Surena Caledon stole the choker from her mentor, Gakin, then fled to join the Defias Brotherhood. She sought power among the bandits hiding in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: How is the choker used in warlock training?
faq.answer: A warlock activates the recovered choker over the summoning circle in the crypts beneath The Slaughtered Lamb. It draws out a Voidwalker, which the aspiring warlock must defeat and subdue to command the demon.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, recovering the Bloodstone Choker marks a passage from basic spellcraft to command of formidable demonic minions.
Surena Caledon’s flight to the Defias Brotherhood shows that outlaws in Elwynn seek dangerous occult relics to strengthen their rebellion against Stormwind.
